_doc: Decisions for the prosrc census (V5-SPACETENANCYKEY-001, multi-space plan V204 step 2.2, DSA-21, MF1). Read by lambda/tenancy-prosrc.static.test.js.

One entry per S table of lambda/tenancy-classes.json (views resolved to their base table) and for public.entity: the function writers of that table in tests/tenancy-prosrc.prod.json, each with a status.

status stamped: the census shows the INSERT naming workspace_id from `value`, a column of the parent row it reads. status rewritten: `file` replaces the body (definition pre-gate from_md5, new body to_md5, stamp); the census shows from_md5 until the sitting and to_md5 after, and the file's body must name workspace_id from `value`. status allowlisted: DEFAULT-reliant or stamped from a refused value until `lane` clears it.

The allowlisted entries are the DB-function half of the writer allowlist (the Lambda half is tests/tenancy-insert-allowlist.json); both must be empty for G5, and 5.7's G2 precondition is a census with no DEFAULT-reliant function writer.
A new S table in the class file needs an entry here (writers [] when no function writes it); a re-run census that finds a new function writer needs a writer entry. The test names both.
